trip.title: Dolomites Trip Dashboard
trip.routeSummary: Lake Garda → Schgaguler Hotel (Kastelruth) → Golden Hill (Dobbiaco / Toblach) → Venice
trip.intro: Built for deep trip operations while traveling: dynamic hotel routes, base-aware recommendations, primary/alternate/bad-weather plans, and quick links to Google Maps, AllTrails, and booking pages. Internal base IDs are kept for web compatibility, but the live trip is optimized for Schgaguler Hotel in Kastelruth on the West side and Golden Hill in Dobbiaco / Toblach on the East side.

seceda_primary.name: [Seceda - Val Gardena] Col Raiser - Seceda - Pieralongia - Rifugio Firenze
seceda_primary.reason: Best blend of jagged ridgeline, green pasture, and huts without too much dead time.
seceda_primary.access: Lift strongly recommended: use the [Col Raiser valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena). Best parking: [Col Raiser valley station parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena); direct-Ortisei backup is [Parking + Garage Seceda](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+Garage+Seceda+Ortisei). Col Raiser is the practical access for this route and keeps the day cleaner than using the direct Seceda line.
seceda_primary.booking: Day-of is usually fine; arrive for first wave.
seceda_primary.trailhead: Col Raiser top station / Seceda ridge trails

seceda_secondary.name: [Seceda - Val Gardena] Seceda - Rifugio Firenze - Col Raiser - Mastlè
seceda_secondary.reason: Slightly more compact Seceda variant with similar payoff.
seceda_secondary.access: Lift strongly recommended: use the [Col Raiser valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena). Best parking: [Col Raiser valley station parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena); direct-Ortisei backup is [Parking + Garage Seceda](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+Garage+Seceda+Ortisei). Col Raiser is the practical access for this route and keeps the day cleaner than using the direct Seceda line.
seceda_secondary.trailhead: Col Raiser top station / Seceda ridge trails

adolf_munkel_primary.name: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Adolf Munkel Trail
adolf_munkel_primary.reason: One of the best meadow + hut + Odle backdrop hikes in the Dolomites.
adolf_munkel_primary.access: No lift. Park at [Zans Parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss). This is the practical trailhead for the classic route; check current Zans/Ranui access rules before you go.
adolf_munkel_primary.cost: Parking fee on site if applicable
adolf_munkel_primary.booking: Reserve if possible; otherwise go early.

adolf_munkel_short.name: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Rifugio delle Odle via Sentiero Adolf Munkel
adolf_munkel_short.reason: Shorter Odle-hut payoff and one of the best practical lower-commitment backups from the Schgaguler base.
adolf_munkel_short.access: No lift. Park at [Zans Parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss). This is the practical trailhead for the classic route; check current Zans/Ranui access rules before you go.
adolf_munkel_short.cost: Parking fee on site if applicable

santa_maddalena_panoramic.name: [Val di Funes - Santa Maddalena] Santa Maddalena: Panoramic Path
santa_maddalena_panoramic.reason: Best church / meadow / village composition for your taste.
santa_maddalena_panoramic.access: No lift. Use [Santa Maddalena village parking / designated visitor parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); backup is the [Puez-Geisler Nature Park Visitor Center area](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena). This is the practical access for the village and church-view area.

santa_maddalena_viewpoint.name: [Val di Funes - Santa Maddalena] Viewpoint Santa Maddalena
santa_maddalena_viewpoint.reason: Best short photo-stop version if you want minimal effort.
santa_maddalena_viewpoint.access: No lift. Use [Santa Maddalena village parking / designated visitor parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); backup is the [Puez-Geisler Nature Park Visitor Center area](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena). This is the practical access for the village and church-view area.

hans_paula_primary.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Hans & Paula Steger Trail
hans_paula_primary.reason: Best low-effort rolling green meadow day with Sassolungo backdrop.
hans_paula_primary.access: Lift recommended: use the [Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway) or the [Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola) if you want the Ortisei side. Best parking: [Car park Silbernagl (P1)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern) for Seis access; early-drive fallback is [Parking P2 Compatsch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch). This works best when you skip the lower road walk and start directly on the plateau.
hans_paula_primary.cost: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip

bullaccia_secondary.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Bullaccia Tour: Witches’ Benches
bullaccia_secondary.reason: Best Alpe di Siusi alternate if you want more viewpoint emphasis.
bullaccia_secondary.access: Lift recommended: use the [Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway). Best parking: [Car park Silbernagl (P1)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern); early-drive fallback is [Parking P2 Compatsch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch). This route is better from the plateau so you spend time on the viewpoints rather than the lower approach.

cinque_torri_primary.name: [Cinque Torri - Cortina d'Ampezzo] Cinque Torri – Averau | Nuvolau Refuge
cinque_torri_primary.reason: Strong scenery-per-hour with broader ridge panoramas than the tiny towers-only loop.
cinque_torri_primary.access: No lift needed, but the chairlift is optional. Park at [Bai de Dones](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones). If you want to skip the lower ascent, use the chairlift from [Bai de Dones](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones).

tre_cime_primary.name: [Tre Cime - Misurina] Three Peaks of Lavaredo
tre_cime_primary.reason: Best iconic white-rock payoff per hour and the most recognizable East Dolomites hike.
tre_cime_primary.access: No lift. Drive to and park at [Rifugio Auronzo parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking). This requires the mandatory Auronzo reservation / road-access ticket.

cadini_primary.name: [Tre Cime / Cadini - Misurina] Cadini di Misurina Panoramic Viewpoint via Auronzo Hut
cadini_primary.reason: Massive reward for little time and best paired with the same Auronzo reservation day.
cadini_primary.access: No lift. Drive to and park at [Rifugio Auronzo parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking). This requires the mandatory Auronzo reservation / road-access ticket.
cadini_primary.cost: Included in same €40 Auronzo road day

sorapis_primary.name: [Lago di Sorapis - Cortina d'Ampezzo] Lake Sorapis via Passo Tre Croci
sorapis_primary.reason: Best turquoise-lake option that still fits your realistic time ceiling.
sorapis_primary.access: No lift. Park near the [Passo Tre Croci trailhead area](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Passo+Tre+Croci). Arrive early because parking is limited.

monte_piz_primary.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Monte Piz – Schgaguler Hut via Monte Sëuc
monte_piz_primary.reason: Best overall Alpe di Siusi ROI from Schgaguler when you use lift access to start directly on the prettier upper plateau.
monte_piz_primary.access: Lift recommended: use the [Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola). Best parking: [Garage Mont Sëuc](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garage+Mont+Seuc+Ortisei) right by the lift; town parking is only a secondary fallback. This route works best with lift access so you skip the less-pretty lower approach and start directly on the upper plateau.
monte_piz_primary.cost: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip; Garage Mont Sëuc parking extra.
monte_piz_primary.booking: Day-of usually fine; go earlier if weather is best in the morning.
monte_piz_primary.trailhead: Mont Sëuc upper station / upper plateau paths

tschotsch_short.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Tschötsch Alm – Puflatsch Bergstation
tschotsch_short.reason: Best ultra-short Alpe di Siusi scenic hit if you want a lighter arrival-day hike with viewpoint payoff.
tschotsch_short.access: Lift recommended: use the [Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway) or, if you prefer Ortisei access, the [Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola). Best parking: [Car park Silbernagl (P1)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern) for Seis access; if you drive onto the plateau very early, use [Parking P2 Compatsch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch). This is the shortest high-ROI plateau option when you want to maximize pretty scenery with minimal time.
tschotsch_short.cost: Seis cable car / plateau access fare or plateau parking fees apply.

bullaccia_primary.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Bullaccia Tour: Witches’ Benches
bullaccia_primary.reason: Best bigger Alpe di Siusi loop when you want more viewpoint drama than Hans & Paula and are fine using lift access.
bullaccia_primary.access: Lift recommended: use the [Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway). Best parking: [Car park Silbernagl (P1)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern); early-drive fallback is [Parking P2 Compatsch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch). This route is better from the plateau so you spend time on the viewpoints rather than the lower approach.
bullaccia_primary.cost: Seis cable car fare or Compatsch parking fees apply.

alpe_family_tour.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Alpe di Siusi Family Tour
alpe_family_tour.reason: Very good easy plateau sampler with broad Dolomite views if you want a softer scenic day without losing the classic Alpe di Siusi look.
alpe_family_tour.access: Lift recommended: use the [Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway) to start directly on the plateau. Best parking: [Car park Silbernagl (P1)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern); if you reach the plateau by car before the road restriction window, [Parking P2 Compatsch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch) is the practical on-plateau start. Good when you want a lower-effort meadow loop with very little unpretty approach.
alpe_family_tour.cost: Seis cable car fare or Compatsch parking fees apply.

urtijei_seiser_alm.name: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Urtijëi - Seiser Alm
urtijei_seiser_alm.reason: A stronger longer Alpe di Siusi option with high visual payoff if you want more plateau time and are happy to use the Mont Sëuc access from Ortisei.
urtijei_seiser_alm.access: Lift recommended: use the [Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola). Best parking: [Garage Mont Sëuc](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garage+Mont+Seuc+Ortisei). This longer plateau day is most efficient when you start at Mont Sëuc and stay high.
urtijei_seiser_alm.cost: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip; parking extra.
urtijei_seiser_alm.booking: Day-of usually fine; clearer weather improves this route.
urtijei_seiser_alm.trailhead: Mont Sëuc upper station / plateau start

zans_glatsch.name: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Zans | Zannes - Malga Glatsch Alm
zans_glatsch.reason: Good lighter Zans-area alternative when you want a hut reward and Odle scenery without committing to the fuller Adolf Munkel outing.
zans_glatsch.access: No lift. Park at [Zans Parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss). This is the practical trailhead for the classic route; check current Zans/Ranui access rules before you go.

sellaronda_drive.name: [Passes - West Dolomites] Sellaronda Scenic Loop [2.5–3 hr]
sellaronda_drive.summary: Best full West-side bad-weather scenic loop from Schgaguler when you still want major pass scenery; slightly less effortless than starting in Ortisei, but still very strong from Kastelruth.

val_di_funes_drive.name: [Val di Funes] Scenic Drive [1.5–2 hr]
val_di_funes_drive.summary: Best lower-valley scenic backup from Schgaguler for churches, meadows, farms, and villages when high ridges are not worth committing to.

great_dolomite_transfer.name: [Hotel transfer - Dolomite passes] Great Dolomites Road practical transfer [3.5–4 hr]
great_dolomite_transfer.summary: Best scenic hotel-transfer route from Schgaguler to Golden Hill, turning the move east into a pass-heavy drive with white-rock drama.

east_bad_weather_loop.name: [East passes + lakes] Passo Giau longer East scenic loop [2.5–3 hr]
east_bad_weather_loop.summary: Longer East-side road day from Golden Hill when hiking is not worthwhile and you still want a fuller dramatic-drive option beyond the Misurina corridor.

tre_cime_misurina_drive.name: [Misurina / Tre Cime approach] Mini-drive [1–1.5 hr]
tre_cime_misurina_drive.summary: Best short East-side scenic fallback from Golden Hill when the full Auronzo or Sorapis commitment is not worth it but you still want nearby lake-and-white-rock scenery.

parkingTable.name: Col Raiser valley station
parkingTable.hours: Official parking page lists it year-round; practical day use follows lift hours.
parkingTable.rate: Parking cost not clearly published on the official page; lift ticket is separate.
parkingTable.fullBy: Usually manageable if you arrive for first wave; target by 08:15-08:30 on clear September days.
parkingTable.backup: Parking + Garage Seceda (backup only if you deliberately switch to the Seceda cableway access).
parkingTable.safety: Standard official lift-station lot in a busy tourist area.

parkingTable.name: Zans Parking
parkingTable.rules: 2026 uses Ranui signal-light system and some pre-bookable spaces.
parkingTable.hours: Day access only; check live traffic-light / reservation status before driving in.
parkingTable.rate: Official online-reservation fee varies by fare; on-site fee can vary.
parkingTable.fullBy: Often full by mid-morning in peak summer; practical target 08:30-09:00 on good-weather days.
parkingTable.backup: Ranui overflow car park, then continue on foot / bus / bike if Zans is red/full.
parkingTable.safety: Standard official park-access lot; very busy on good-weather days.

parkingTable.name: Santa Maddalena village / visitor-center area
parkingTable.rules: Use designated village parking and follow local signs; exact official English lot naming is not clear.
parkingTable.hours: Village/daytime access; no lift window to catch.
parkingTable.rate: Local village fee; exact rate can vary.
parkingTable.fullBy: Photo spots get busy, but parking is usually easier than high-icon trailheads.
parkingTable.backup: Puez-Geisler Nature Park Visitor Center area.

parkingTable.name: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola valley station
parkingTable.rules: Simplest gondola access for this itinerary.
parkingTable.hours: Use Mont Sëuc gondola hours for planning; garage is at the bottom station.
parkingTable.rate: Lift ticket separate; garage chargeable, but official price not clearly published.
parkingTable.fullBy: Usually worth arriving by about 08:15-08:30 on strong-weather mornings.
parkingTable.backup: Ortisei town garages / Seceda garage only if you are changing access strategy.

parkingTable.name: P1 Spitzbühl
parkingTable.rules: Road restricted 9:00–17:00; can close earlier when full.
parkingTable.hours: No parking 23:00-06:00 in the nature-protection area.
parkingTable.rate: €15/vehicle cash only; includes one discounted Spitzbühl lift or bus-line-14 ticket.
parkingTable.fullBy: Can fill early on strong-weather weekends; target before 08:30 if driving up.
parkingTable.backup: P2 Compatsch, or leave the car at Seis valley station and use the cableway.

parkingTable.name: P2 Compatsch
parkingTable.rules: Road restricted 9:00–17:00; machine payment before exit.
parkingTable.hours: No parking 23:00-06:00; road access only before 09:00 and after 17:00 while cableway season is running.
parkingTable.fullBy: Can fill early on prime days; target before 08:30 if you insist on driving up.
parkingTable.backup: P1 Spitzbühl, or Seis valley-station parking + cableway.
parkingTable.safety: Official plateau parking with barrier / ticket system.

parkingTable.name: Bai de Dones
parkingTable.rules: Chairlift optional; current summer first runs around 9:00.
parkingTable.hours: Accessible all day for the Cinque Torri chairlift area.
parkingTable.rate: Parking commonly treated as free; optional chairlift ticket separate.
parkingTable.fullBy: Recent traveler reports suggest it can be crowded by roughly 08:45-09:30 on prime days.
parkingTable.backup: Park lower / farther away and walk, or skip the chairlift and start from the base area if capacity allows.

parkingTable.name: Rifugio Auronzo Parking
parkingTable.rules: Mandatory online reservation; permit valid 12 hours.
parkingTable.hours: Entry tied to your booked 12-hour slot; permit expires when you exit.
parkingTable.rate: Reservation / road-access fee per car per 12-hour slot.
parkingTable.fullBy: Capacity is managed by reservation rather than a normal first-come lot.
parkingTable.backup: If sold out, use bus access from Dobbiaco / Cortina / Auronzo instead.
parkingTable.safety: Official managed high-mountain parking with permit control.

parkingTable.name: Passo Tre Croci area
parkingTable.rules: No lift. Arrive early for parking.
parkingTable.hours: Roadside / small-lot style parking at the trailhead area.
parkingTable.rate: Often treated as free or standard roadside parking; exact local setup can vary.
parkingTable.fullBy: Arrive very early; practical target around 07:00-07:30 on clear days.
parkingTable.backup: Look for signed Sorapis parking slightly downhill / along the road, or return later in the day when hikers leave.
parkingTable.safety: Standard roadside / trailhead parking; do not block traffic.

parkingTable.name: Garage Mont Sëuc
parkingTable.serves: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc lift access
parkingTable.rules: Chargeable garage at the bottom station of the Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola. Best practical parking for Monte Piz and Urtijëi - Seiser Alm.
parkingTable.hours: Chargeable garage at the bottom station; official price not clearly published.
parkingTable.rate: Varies by season; exact price not reliably published in the official listing retrieved.
parkingTable.fullBy: Best to target 08:15-08:30 on strong-weather mornings.
parkingTable.backup: Central Ortisei garages or Setil if you only need town parking; Seceda garage only if changing access plan.

parkingTable.name: Car park Silbernagl (P1)
parkingTable.rules: Covered parking at the valley station area of the Seiser Alm cableway; good practical choice for Bullaccia, Family Tour, and other Compatsch-side hikes.
parkingTable.hours: Valley-station garage; cableway access starts from 08:00 in season.
parkingTable.rate: €2/hour, max €8/day; 7 days €35. New valley-station lot is €2.50/hour, €12/day from the 4th hour.
parkingTable.fullBy: Usually better than forcing Compatsch; still worth arriving by about 08:15-08:30 on prime days.
parkingTable.backup: New valley-station car park or use the cableway-area surface parking if available.

parkingTable.name: Parking + Garage Seceda
parkingTable.serves: Direct Seceda lift backup access from Ortisei
parkingTable.rules: Chargeable parking at the Seceda cableway bottom station; useful backup access point but not the primary recommendation for the Col Raiser-based Seceda route.
parkingTable.cost: €4/hour daytime listed on Dolomiti Superski parking page.
parkingTable.hours: Open year-round; price bands published 07:00-19:00 and 19:00-07:00.
parkingTable.rate: €4/hour daytime, €0.80/hour overnight; price may vary by season.
parkingTable.fullBy: Good backup, but on clear days aim by about 08:15 if you need it.
parkingTable.safety: Official central Ortisei garage with published hours.

bookings.note: Mandatory for Day 6; reserve when date opens. [Official Auronzo reservation / parking page](https://auronzo.info/en/parking-tre-cime-di-lavaredo/)

Review the current Zans / Ranui reservation-access rules before the Adolf Munkel day. [Current Zans / Ranui access notes](https://wildconnectionsphotography.com/new-2026-access-restrictions-in-the-dolomites/)
Day-of purchase usually fine if you arrive early. [Col Raiser official site](https://www.colraiser.it/en/)
Day-of purchase usually fine. [Seiser Alm cable cars / tickets](https://www.seiseralm.it/en/active/summer-holidays/hiking/cable-cars.html)

d1_arrival_santa_short.title: [Val di Funes - Santa Maddalena] Viewpoint Santa Maddalena [1.5–2 hr]
d1_arrival_santa_short.summary: Fallback arrival-day church/meadow stop if the plateau is too clouded in or you prefer to avoid lift logistics on Day 1.
d1_arrival_santa_short.whenToUse: Use on arrival day if higher terrain is not worth it or if you want a no-lift backup.
logistics: No lift needed.

Best parking: [Santa Maddalena village / designated parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); backup is the [Puez-Geisler Nature Park Visitor Center area](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena).
d1_arrival_santa_short.mentalMap: Church-view and meadow stop with lower weather commitment than a plateau hike.

d1_arrival_town_reset.title: Kastelruth reset / town time [flex]
d1_arrival_town_reset.summary: Skip hiking and ease into the trip with a quiet first afternoon in Kastelruth.
d1_arrival_town_reset.whenToUse: Best if arrival is delayed or energy is low.
logistics: No parking/logistics stress.
Good for settling in and preserving energy.
d1_arrival_town_reset.mentalMap: Simple arrival buffer in your actual base village.

d1_val_di_funes_drive.title: Val di Funes Scenic Drive [1.5–2 hr]
d1_val_di_funes_drive.summary: Best mixed/bad-weather fallback from Schgaguler on arrival when you still want villages, churches, and meadow scenery.
d1_val_di_funes_drive.whenToUse: Use when peaks are clouded in but valley scenery is still visible.
logistics: Flexible scenic stops.
Easy to shorten if weather worsens.
d1_val_di_funes_drive.mentalMap: Villages, church views, meadows, and easier visibility than high ridges.

d2_seceda_primary.title: [Seceda - Val Gardena] Col Raiser - Seceda - Pieralongia - Rifugio Firenze [4.5–5 hr]
d2_seceda_primary.summary: Your clearest-sky West-side hero day, now routed from Schgaguler.
d2_seceda_primary.whenToUse: Use on the clearest West-side day.
logistics: Park at [Col Raiser valley station parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena).

Lift strongly recommended: [Col Raiser valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Col+Raiser+Val+Gardena). Direct-Ortisei backup is [Parking + Garage Seceda](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+Garage+Seceda+Ortisei).
bookings: Arrive for the first wave; day-of purchase usually fine.
d2_seceda_primary.mentalMap: Dramatic ridgeline above green pastures and huts.

d2_adolf_short_alt.title: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Rifugio delle Odle via Sentiero Adolf Munkel [3 h 7 min]
d2_adolf_short_alt.summary: Lower-commitment alternate if Seceda feels too weather-sensitive or you want less exposure.
d2_adolf_short_alt.whenToUse: Best if weather is mixed, visibility is decent in the valley, or you want a shorter/meadow-focused day.
logistics: No lift. Park at [Zans Parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss).
Reserve/check access if possible and watch the Ranui signal system.
bookings: Reserve if possible; otherwise go early.

d2_sellaronda_bad.title: Sellaronda Scenic Loop [2.5–3 hr]
d2_sellaronda_bad.summary: Best true bad-weather fallback from Schgaguler if Seceda is not worth committing to.
d2_sellaronda_bad.whenToUse: Use when high hiking terrain is not worth it.
logistics: Road-trip day with multiple pass pull-offs.
Easy to shorten or extend.
d2_sellaronda_bad.mentalMap: Pass-driven wow-factor day instead of committing to a lift.

d3_adolf_primary.title: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Adolf Munkel Trail [~5 hr]
d3_adolf_primary.summary: Best meadow + hut + Odle wall day of the trip.
d3_adolf_primary.whenToUse: Use when you want one of the strongest beauty-per-effort meadow hikes.
logistics: No lift. Park at [Zans Parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss).
Reserve/check access if possible and watch the Ranui signal system.
d3_adolf_primary.mentalMap: Open meadow trail with hut and toothy Odle backdrop.

d3_santa_alt.title: [Val di Funes - Santa Maddalena] Santa Maddalena: Panoramic Path [3.5–4 hr]
d3_santa_alt.summary: Lower-effort church/meadow day if you want something softer and more village-oriented.
d3_santa_alt.whenToUse: Best if you feel tired or want lower-commitment scenery.
logistics: No lift needed.

Best parking: [Santa Maddalena village / designated parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); backup is the [Puez-Geisler Nature Park Visitor Center area](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena).
d3_santa_alt.mentalMap: Church, fields, farms, and postcard framing.

d3_val_bad.title: Val di Funes Scenic Drive [1.5–2 hr]
d3_val_bad.summary: Best true poor-weather replacement for Adolf Munkel from the Schgaguler base.
d3_val_bad.whenToUse: Use when summit visibility is poor or rain/storm risk is too high.
logistics: Easy scenic day with photo stops.
Can pair with a very short Santa Maddalena walk.

d4_alpe_primary.title: [Val di Funes - Santa Maddalena] Santa Maddalena: Panoramic Path [3.5–4 hr]
d4_alpe_primary.summary: Use Day 4 for the softer church / meadow / village day after your bigger West-side hikes.
d4_alpe_primary.whenToUse: Best on a mixed-weather day or when you want a more relaxed scenic day before moving east.
logistics: No lift needed.

Best parking: [Santa Maddalena village / designated parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Santa+Maddalena+Funes+Italy); backup is the [Puez-Geisler Nature Park Visitor Center area](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Puez-Geisler+Nature+Park+Visitor+Center+Santa+Maddalena).
d4_alpe_primary.mentalMap: Church, fields, farms, and postcard framing.

d4_bullaccia_alt.title: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Bullaccia Tour: Witches’ Benches [3–3.5 hr]
d4_bullaccia_alt.summary: Use this if Day 1 weather was poor and you still want a stronger plateau day before moving east.
d4_bullaccia_alt.whenToUse: Best if you did not already use one of the higher-payoff Alpe di Siusi hikes on Day 1.
logistics: Lift recommended: use the [Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway).

Best parking: [Car park Silbernagl (P1)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern); early-drive fallback is [Parking P2 Compatsch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch).
costs: Same lift / parking costs as primary plateau access

d4_sellaronda_bad.title: Sellaronda Scenic Loop [2.5–3 hr]
d4_sellaronda_bad.summary: Best full bad-weather backup for the plateau day.
d4_sellaronda_bad.whenToUse: Use when lift/plateau weather is not worth committing to.
logistics: Pass loop with easy scenic pull-offs.
d4_sellaronda_bad.mentalMap: Road-based pass scenery in place of the plateau.

d5_transfer_cinque.title: Great Dolomites Road practical transfer [3.5–4 hr] + [Cinque Torri - Cortina d'Ampezzo] Cinque Torri – Averau | Nuvolau Refuge [3.5–5 hr]
d5_transfer_cinque.summary: Use the move from Schgaguler to Golden Hill efficiently with scenic pass driving and a medium-effort rocky-rifugio hike.
d5_transfer_cinque.whenToUse: Best as the main hotel-transfer day from Schgaguler to Golden Hill.

accessRoutes.label: Schgaguler → scenic transfer → Bai de Dones → Golden Hill
Bai de Dones parking → Golden Hill

logistics: Park at [Bai de Dones](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones).
Optional chairlift from [Bai de Dones](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones) if you want to skip the lower ascent.
d5_transfer_cinque.mentalMap: No-wasted-transfer day through dramatic passes and rifugi.

d5_transfer_drive_only.title: Great Dolomites Road practical transfer [3.5–4 hr]
d5_transfer_drive_only.summary: Best if weather is not good enough to justify Cinque Torri hiking on the transfer from Schgaguler to Golden Hill.
d5_transfer_drive_only.whenToUse: Use when the drive itself will still be rewarding but the hike is not worth the effort.
logistics: Use this as the default fallback if hiking conditions are poor.
d5_transfer_drive_only.mentalMap: Scenic relocation day through the passes without forcing a hike.

d6_trecime_primary.title: [Tre Cime - Misurina] Three Peaks of Lavaredo [3.5–4 hr] + [Tre Cime / Cadini - Misurina] Cadini di Misurina Panoramic Viewpoint via Auronzo Hut [1.5–2 hr]
d6_trecime_primary.summary: Biggest icon day of the trip, using one Auronzo booking efficiently.
d6_trecime_primary.whenToUse: Use on the clearest East-side day.
logistics: No lift. Drive to and park at [Rifugio Auronzo parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking).
This requires the mandatory Auronzo reservation / road-access ticket.
d6_trecime_primary.mentalMap: Hero white-rock day with the two most iconic Auronzo-zone payoffs.

d6_cinque_alt.title: [Cinque Torri - Cortina d'Ampezzo] Cinque Torri – Averau | Nuvolau Refuge [3.5–5 hr]
d6_cinque_alt.summary: Use if the Tre Cime day is not getting the sky it deserves.
d6_cinque_alt.whenToUse: Best if East-side high icons are too clouded, but mid-elevation pass scenery still works.
logistics: Park at [Bai de Dones](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones).
Optional chairlift from [Bai de Dones](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bai+de+Dones).

d6_east_drive_bad.title: Passo Giau longer East scenic loop [2.5–3 hr]
d6_east_drive_bad.summary: Longer true bad-weather replacement for the Auronzo hero day if you still want a full road-trip day from Golden Hill.
d6_east_drive_bad.whenToUse: Use when cloud cover or storm risk makes the Auronzo reservation not worthwhile.
logistics: Good road-based East-side scenery with easy stops from Golden Hill.
d6_east_drive_bad.mentalMap: Longer pass-and-lake day when you still want a fuller East scenic drive.

d7_sorapis_primary.title: [Lago di Sorapis - Cortina d'Ampezzo] Lake Sorapis via Passo Tre Croci [4.5–5.5 hr]
d7_sorapis_primary.summary: Primary East follow-up if weather is decent after your Tre Cime day.
d7_sorapis_primary.whenToUse: Use when weather is decent and you still want one final substantial East-side hike.

accessRoutes.label: Hotel → Passo Tre Croci parking area

logistics: No lift. Park near the [Passo Tre Croci trailhead area](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Passo+Tre+Croci).
Arrive early because parking is limited.
d7_sorapis_primary.mentalMap: Turquoise-lake day with a more adventurous feel than the meadow hikes.

d7_trecime_swap_alt.title: [Tre Cime - Misurina] Three Peaks of Lavaredo [3.5–4 hr] + [Tre Cime / Cadini - Misurina] Cadini di Misurina Panoramic Viewpoint via Auronzo Hut [1.5–2 hr]
d7_trecime_swap_alt.summary: Use this if Day 6 weather was poor and you saved the Auronzo reservation for today.
d7_trecime_swap_alt.whenToUse: Best if yesterday was clouded out but today is clear.
logistics: No lift. Drive to and park at [Rifugio Auronzo parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rifugio+Auronzo+Parking).
This requires the mandatory Auronzo reservation / road-access ticket.
d7_trecime_swap_alt.mentalMap: Weather-flex swap version of the hero day.

d7_east_drive_bad.title: Passo Giau longer East scenic loop [2.5–3 hr]
d7_east_drive_bad.summary: Longer East-side scenic fallback on the final Dolomites day if you want a fuller drive than the Misurina corridor.
d7_east_drive_bad.whenToUse: Use when a full Sorapis hike is not worth it.
logistics: Good road-based East-side scenery with easy stops from Golden Hill.
d7_east_drive_bad.mentalMap: Longer East scenic day with passes, villages, and Misurina.

d8_venice_transfer.title: Golden Hill → Venice transfer [~2.5 hr]
d8_venice_transfer.summary: Simple exit day from Golden Hill with optional Misurina stop if weather is beautiful.
logistics: Optional short lake stop if skies are beautiful.
d8_venice_transfer.mentalMap: Clean exit with optional final scenic pause.

d1_alpe_primary.title: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Monte Piz – Schgaguler Hut via Monte Sëuc [2–2.5 hr]
d1_alpe_primary.summary: Best use of your short Lake Garda transfer day: check in at Schgaguler, use lift access, and spend the afternoon on the pretty plateau.
d1_alpe_primary.whenToUse: Use on arrival day when weather up high is decent and you want the strongest beauty-per-hour start.

accessRoutes.label: Garage Mont Sëuc parking → Ortisei town after hike

logistics: Lift recommended: use the [Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola).
Best parking: [Garage Mont Sëuc](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garage+Mont+Seuc+Ortisei) right at the lift station.
Use lift access to skip the less interesting approach and keep time for Ortisei town later.
costs: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip
bookings: Day-of usually fine; earlier is better if you want more buffer.
d1_alpe_primary.mentalMap: Fast transfer, pretty high meadow hike, then town time.

d1_tschotsch_alt.title: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Tschötsch Alm – Puflatsch Bergstation [1.5–2 hr]
d1_tschotsch_alt.summary: Shorter scenic plateau outing if you want to keep Day 1 especially easy.
d1_tschotsch_alt.whenToUse: Best if you arrive a little later or want a lighter first day.
logistics: Lift recommended: use the [Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway).

Best parking: [Car park Silbernagl (P1)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern); early-drive fallback is [Parking P2 Compatsch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch).
Best short scenic plateau option if you want a lower-commitment Day 1.
d1_tschotsch_alt.mentalMap: Short, scenic plateau sampler with time left for town.

d6_misurina_drive_bad.title: Tre Cime / Misurina approach mini-drive [1–1.5 hr]
d6_misurina_drive_bad.summary: Closest low-commitment scenic replacement from Golden Hill if the Auronzo reservation or upper-hike weather is not worth forcing.
d6_misurina_drive_bad.whenToUse: Use when visibility is mixed or unstable and you want a nearby half-day fallback rather than a long road loop.
logistics: Short East-side lake-and-white-rock fallback from Golden Hill with easy roadside stops.
d6_misurina_drive_bad.mentalMap: Nearby lake-and-approach scenery instead of forcing the hero day.

d7_misurina_drive_alt.title: Tre Cime / Misurina approach mini-drive [1–1.5 hr]
d7_misurina_drive_alt.summary: Closest half-day scenic fallback from Golden Hill if you do not want to commit to Sorapis on the final full day.
d7_misurina_drive_alt.whenToUse: Use when weather is mixed or energy is lower and you want a shorter drive than Passo Giau.
logistics: Short East-side lake-and-white-rock fallback from Golden Hill with easy roadside stops.

d1_family_alt.title: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Alpe di Siusi Family Tour [2–2.5 hr]
d1_family_alt.summary: Easy scenic plateau option if you want broad meadows and classic Dolomite backdrop without pushing the first day too much.
d1_family_alt.whenToUse: Best if you arrive on time but want a softer, more relaxed first hike than Monte Piz.
logistics: Lift recommended: use the [Seis–Seiser Alm cableway valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seis+Seiser+Alm+Aerial+Cableway).

Best parking: [Car park Silbernagl (P1)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Car+park+Silbernagl+P1+Seis+am+Schlern); early-drive fallback is [Parking P2 Compatsch](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parking+P2+Compatsch).
Easy meadow-forward option with very little unpretty approach.
costs: Seis cable car fare or plateau parking fees apply.
d1_family_alt.mentalMap: Easy upper-plateau meadows and views with less commitment.

d4_urtijei_alt.title: [Alpe di Siusi - Seiser Alm] Urtijëi - Seiser Alm [3.5–4 hr]
d4_urtijei_alt.summary: Use this if Day 1 weather was poor and you want a fuller Mont Sëuc / Alpe di Siusi day before moving east.
d4_urtijei_alt.whenToUse: Best if you want more plateau time and are happy to trade a bit more effort for scenery.
logistics: Lift recommended: use the [Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi / Mont Sëuc gondola valley station](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ortisei+Alpe+di+Siusi+Gondola).
Best parking: [Garage Mont Sëuc](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Garage+Mont+Seuc+Ortisei) right at the lift station.
costs: Ortisei–Alpe di Siusi gondola €35 round trip; parking extra.
d4_urtijei_alt.mentalMap: Longer open-plateau loop with Mont Sëuc access.

d3_zans_glatsch_alt.title: [Val di Funes - Puez-Odle] Zans | Zannes - Malga Glatsch Alm [3.5–4.5 hr]
d3_zans_glatsch_alt.summary: Lighter Val di Funes / Zans backup if you want an easier hut-and-meadow day than the full Adolf Munkel classic.
d3_zans_glatsch_alt.whenToUse: Best when weather is decent but you want a lower-effort valley day.
logistics: No lift. Park at [Zans Parking](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Zans+Parking+Villnoss).
Reserve/check access if possible and watch the Ranui signal system.
d3_zans_glatsch_alt.mentalMap: Shorter Zans hut loop with Odle backdrop.
